auckland: Our first destination — walking in the harbor, good food, and recovering from jetlag.
waiheke: Beautiful island with wineries and beaches.
waiheke-bike: Explored Waiheke's vineyards, beaches, and architecture by eBike.
queenstown: Straight from the airport toward Wanaka.
crown-range: Spectacular mountain road between Queenstown and Wanaka.
wanaka: Campervan pickup and off to the first hike.
roys-peak: First hike. Tough climb and stunning views.
red-bridge-camp: First freedom camping night. Large parking area just outside Wanaka.
queenstown-paknsave: Toilets, wifi, and grocery store! Our regular stop.
te-anau: Overnight stop on the way to Fiordland — atmospheric lakeside town.
lake-marian: Easy-ish hike to an alpine lake.
milford-sound: Worth every penny cruise on the fiord.
gertrude-saddle: One of the most stunning hikes — only in good weather!
earnslaw-burn: Most challenging hike, most beautiful scenery. Night in a tent among mountains and waterfalls.
queenstown-camp: Post-hike Fergburgers and overnight in busy Queenstown.
arrowtown: Celebrating Christmas in a charming village.
lake-tekapo: Turquoise glacier lake and lots of tourists in Tekapo.
mackenzie-rv-camp: Roadside parking with plenty of space.
tekapo-spa: Rest day at the spa and saunas.
lake-pukaki: Huge parking area with great views. Windy!
mt-cook: Mountain village, good base for multiple hikes.
sealy-tarns: Long stairs, option to continue to Mueller Hut.
blue-lakes: Easy, quick walk to turquoise lakes and glacier views.
chamberlains-ford: Locals' favorite campsite, noisy. Nice river nearby.
christchurch: Quick visit to a nice market hall.
akaroa: Charming village at the end of a steep mountain road. One of the best spots!
akaroa-kayaking: Guided kayaking trip near the harbor.
bealey-spur: Easy hike, done for the exercise.
devils-punch-bowl: Short but surprisingly steep trail to the waterfall base.
jacksons: Peaceful camping with glowworms as a specialty.
franz-josef: Visiting a friend. Lots of restaurants, bars, and tourists.
orange-sheep: Nice small camping in rainforest setting with central location.
alex-knob: Surprisingly easy hike with glacier views.
brewster-trailhead: Stayed overnight at the trailhead. Not an official campsite.
brewster-hut: One of the toughest climbs. Very cute hut and option to continue to the glacier.
blue-pools: Very easy walk to a crystal-clear, ice-cold river pool. Definitely swim!
red-bridge-camp-return: Full circle back to our first freedom camping spot.
wanaka-center: Campervan drop-off and exploring Wanaka — nice tourist destination.
hampshire-wanaka: Overnight in a cute cabin at the campground.
black-sheep: Hostel in Queenstown — this one has a sauna!
wellington: Food, botanical garden, harbor, and Cable Car.
porirua: Really cute Airbnb in Porirua. Cozy-looking place!
powell-hut: Trail start very easy, steep climb to the hut at the end.
waimarama: Morning surf lesson at Waimarama Beach.
napier: Lunch stop in a pleasant coastal town.
taupo: Hot water beach and lots of restaurants.
spa-park: Otumuheke Stream — amazing riverside with hot springs.
tongariro-start: Park the car and bus to the trailhead.
tongariro: Beautiful but very touristy long hike.
mt-maunganui: Easy but surprisingly beautiful coastal trail.
tairua: Really nice village and our best Airbnb.
pinnacles-trailhead: Great swimming spot favored by locals along the way.
pinnacles: Easy-ish hike to a large hut. Return possible via different route.
auckland-airport: Rental car return and heading home.
home: Time to plan the next trip <3
